bookSourceComment: 图库漫画 - 免费日韩漫画在线阅读平台 网站: https://www.tuku.cc 类型: 漫画源 (bookSourceType=2) 编码: UTF-8 === 规则说明 === 1. 搜索使用GET请求, 参数为title (非keyword), URL格式: /search?title={key}&page={page} 2. 详情页URL格式: /manga-{ID}/ 3. 章节URL格式: /chapter{ID}/ 4. 分类页URL支持组合: /comics-{tag}-{order}-p{page}/ (已验证支持) 5. 排行榜URL格式: /rank/ 或 /rank/?t={1-6} 6. 漫画图片使用jQuery懒加载, 真实URL在data-original属性中 7. 正文使用JS包装图片URL为标签 8. 下一章链接在.read-footer区域, 文本为'下一话' 9. 图片防盗链: 已在header中添加Referer: https://www.tuku.cc/ === 发现页(按钮筛选, 参考起点中文网) === 4个主切换项: - 人气热门: 子分类为题材(全部/热血/恋爱/百合等) - 更新时间: 子分类为题材 - 新品上架: 子分类为题材 - 排行榜: 子分类为榜单类型(人气榜/完结榜/少年榜等) URL组合示例: - 人气热门+热血: /comics-tag1-p1/ - 更新时间+热血: /comics-tag1-order2-p1/ - 排行榜+完结榜: /rank/?t=1

<js>
var result = [];

var categoryMap = {
    "分类": "category",
    "更新": "update",
    "排行": "ranking"
};

var categoryType = infoMap["分类"] || "分类";
var ct = categoryMap[categoryType];

result.push({
    "title": "分类",
    "type": "select",
    "chars": ["分类", "更新", "排行"],
    "default": categoryType,
    "action": "java.refreshExplore()",
    "style": {"layout_flexGrow": 1, "layout_flexBasisPercent": 1}
});

if (ct === "category") {
    var tags = ["全部","正妹","恋爱","出版漫画","肉慾","浪漫","大尺度","巨乳","有夫之婦","女大生","狗血劇","同居","好友","調教","动作","後宮","不倫","3D","校園","耽美","日漫"];
    var tagMap = {
        "全部": "all", "正妹": "%E6%AD%A3%E5%A6%B9", "恋爱": "%E6%81%8B%E7%88%B1", "出版漫画": "%E5%87%BA%E7%89%88%E6%BC%AB%E7%94%BB",
        "肉慾": "%E8%82%89%E6%85%BE", "浪漫": "%E6%B5%AA%E6%BC%AB", "大尺度": "%E5%A4%A7%E5%B0%BA%E5%BA%A6", "巨乳": "%E5%B7%A8%E4%B9%B3",
        "有夫之婦": "%E6%9C%89%E5%A4%AB%E4%B9%8B%E5%A9%A6", "女大生": "%E5%A5%B3%E5%A4%A7%E7%94%9F", "狗血劇": "%E7%8B%97%E8%A1%80%E5%8A%87", "同居": "%E5%90%8C%E5%B1%85",
        "好友": "%E5%A5%BD%E5%8F%8B", "調教": "%E8%AA%BF%E6%95%99", "动作": "%E5%8A%A8%E4%BD%9C", "後宮": "%E5%BE%8C%E5%AE%AE",
        "不倫": "%E4%B8%8D%E5%80%AB", "3D": "3D", "校園": "%E6%A0%A1%E5%9C%92", "耽美": "%E8%80%BD%E7%BE%8E", "日漫": "%E6%97%A5%E6%BC%AB"
    };
    for (var i = 0; i < tags.length; i++) {
        var t = tags[i];
        var url = "/comics/" + tagMap[t] + "/ob/time/st/all/page/{{page}}";
        result.push({
            "title": t,
            "url": url,
            "style": {"layout_flexGrow": 1, "layout_flexBasisPercent": 0.25}
        });
    }
} else if (ct === "update") {
    var ups = ["最新更新", "新书发布", "推荐漫画"];
    var upUrls = ["/update", "/update/newbook", "/update/recommend"];
    for (var i = 0; i < ups.length; i++) {
        result.push({
            "title": ups[i],
            "url": upUrls[i],
            "style": {"layout_flexGrow": 1, "layout_flexBasisPercent": 1}
        });
    }
} else if (ct === "ranking") {
    var ranks = ["总榜", "周榜", "日榜", "月榜"];
    var rankUrls = ["/ranking", "/ranking/weekly", "/ranking/daily", "/ranking/monthly"];
    for (var i = 0; i < ranks.length; i++) {
        result.push({
            "title": ranks[i],
            "url": rankUrls[i],
            "style": {"layout_flexGrow": 1, "layout_flexBasisPercent": 0.5}
        });
    }
}

JSON.stringify(result);
</js>
